# Wickenden Instruments - staff handbook

Standard leave entitlements are listed in `handbook/entitlements.csv`, one row per entitlement. The handbook grants exactly what the table lists; anything beyond it is agreed case by case with a director and never counts as standard.

Working-pattern detail is kept under `docs/`.

files.docs/working-patterns.md:
# Working patterns

Laboratory technicians run the early rota two weeks in every four. Field engineers accumulate time off in lieu for overnight calls, and the balance is checked at the January review.
